prompt: Flat 2D fantasy video game boss art: one colossal cosmic sovereign seen from the front from the waist up. Its head is a perfect, featureless, pitch-black eclipse disc ringed by a thin white-hot rim and a crown of ember orange, gold and white flame streamers. Its broad torso and shoulders are heavy black-gold plate armour engraved with gold lines and glowing ember seams. Around its body turns a vast orrery: three interlocking engraved armillary rings of black iron and gold, tilted at different angles, passing in front of and behind the torso. Four small glowing planets ride the rings: a frost cyan planet, an ember orange planet, a deep teal planet and a storm white planet. Its two colossal armoured gauntlets with gold claws rest at the lower left and lower right corners. Plain flat grey background, nothing else. Crisp hard edges, flat cel shading with few tones, high contrast, light from the upper left.
